description: Exception note: an open Collection failed Exception with a Collection failed Tracking event from the Carrier and no action taken yet. Known answer: a note of two to five sentences saying what happened in order and that the Shipper has not been notified; the Exception stays open.

setup.seed: Take a Shipment to a Collection failed Tracking event (Carrier remark "Nobody at the site"), which opens the Exception. Do not notify the Shipper. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Exception's number.

input: Draft a short internal note on the Exception ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, of what has happened and what is outstanding.

explanation.rubric: A note of two to five plain sentences. Says what happened from the timeline in order, quotes the remark as a quotation, says the Shipper has not been notified and that the Exception stays open. States no outcome.
